data.body: Landed as Gerrit 3157 (9bd1d5f8124 on main; Gerrit rebased on submit) at LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on patch set 2 (run 41137845919). Patch set 1 failed only CI lint on the GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 zizmor finding in release.yml, fixed on main by cuneiform-armoured-maiasaura (778c969e4f1); patch set 2 is a clean rebase onto it. Each acceptance criterion maps to tests in tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_ref_lock_chain.py (named-ref pushes, chaining, 4 races, release and gate markers, legacy blob tips, error surfacing), tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py (remote name), tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py and the bridge pause/resume held-out tests, the scratch-bucket comment above, and the ADR 0031 / ADR 0093 / s3-backend.md changes.
